news_summary: NASA has awarded $20 million to a University of Arizona team led by Bengaluru-born astronomer Ramya Anche to build PUFFINS, a small space telescope that will study interstellar dust.
payoff: PUFFINS data can help define a future instrument for NASA's Habitable Worlds Observatory.
